title: Laboratory Domains (DOM)
text:
The conception and application of the concept of concentration of knowledge requires the laboratory to also function and maintain a structural system for DOM, i.e. domain type concentration of knowledge. For example, as would be listed, the mathematics and physics knowledge concentration, as well as the philosophical and social science concentration. One thing you would realize is that they resemble the foundational and fundamental fields and area of operation of each laboratory’s department and specialized architecture. So, reflections, and streamlined execution as well as coordination, is what we are to aim for.

title: Laboratory and domains
text:
A lot of times, a laboratory is constrained to one fundamental core group. Over in RHINELAB, compartmentalization but with cross-communication is of the utmost importance, especially when considering the foundational philosophy and the structural architecture laid out by the founder. Therefore, the category of @LABORATORY is formed, in which they are to segment and enact the condition for divide and conquer, as well as self-sustainment of each individual laboratories and their comfort zone.

title: Welcome to RHINELAB
text: Welcome to RHINELAB, a laboratory dedicated for open advanced scientific researches. We are a community of prospective students, independent researchers, theoreticians and researchers with diverse backgrounds in most area of science, pure/natural science and technological science, which includes pure mathematics, physics and theoretical computer science and artificial intelligence but not shying from social science and philosophy. Here, our lab works within the foundations of knowledge, the logistics for sciences and archives of scientific artifacts, institutional science and organization science for operating and managing the laboratory itself, and also frontier sciences in social science, literature, psychology, neuroscience, quantum physics and field theories, quantum foundational material science, artificial intelligence, philosophy of sciences and physics, and more theoretical research.
